## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::GovernanceVetoWindowClosed` — a veto was attempted after the veto window closed.

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Veto before the veto window closes; after the execution instant the proposal can only be executed, not vetoed.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#1-governance-model`](../../docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#1-governance-model)
